castTime.binNote: Bin lists castTime 0.3 for ZoeE, but the wiki template states cast time = {{fd|0.25}}; recording the wiki's value as instructed and flagging the disagreement.

values.meaning: Window after sleep ends in which the bonus true damage can still be applied

mechanics.claim: The burst inflicts drowsy (a gradual slow) that culminates in the target falling asleep.
mechanics.quote: The burst deals {{as|magic damage}} to the target and inflicts them with {{tip|drowsy}} for {{fd|1.4}} seconds, which gradually {{tip|slows}} them until they fall {{tip|sleep|asleep}} for {{fd|2.25}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: While asleep, the target has 30% magic resistance reduction, increasing magic damage dealt to it.
mechanics.quote: While the target is {{tip|sleep|asleep}}, they are inflicted with {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|30% magic resistance reduction}}}}.

mechanics.claim: The next non-persistent damage instance against the sleeping target (from champions/large monsters/turrets) is upgraded: it wakes the target and adds bonus true damage equal to the post-mitigation damage of that hit, capped at the bubble's damage value.
mechanics.quote: The next instance of non-{{tip|persistent damage|persistent}} damage from {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|monsters}} or {{tip|turrets}} against the {{tip|sleep|sleeping}} target consumes the debuff to deal {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}} equal to the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt, capped at ''Sleepy Trouble Bubble's'' damage.

mechanics.claim: The wake-up bonus true damage can still trigger up to 1 second after sleep ends if not yet consumed.
mechanics.quote: This '''bonus''' damage may also be applied within 1 second of the {{tip|sleep}} ending, if the debuff was not consumed.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield does not prevent the target from falling asleep or block the wake-up true damage, but it does block the bubble's own damage and drowsy application.
mechanics.quote:
{{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent falling {{tip|sleep|asleep}} nor block the wake-up damage.
** The bubble's damage and {{tip|drowsy}} application will be blocked.

mechanics.claim: The bubble's initial burst applies as spell damage, while the wake-up bonus damage applies as proc damage (a separate, non-redirectable instance).
mechanics.quote: Applies {{tip|spell damage}} for the bubble and {{tip|proc damage}} for the wake-up damage.

mechanics.claim: Landing a hit on an enemy champion refunds a percentage of the ability's cooldown.
mechanics.quote: ''Sleepy Trouble Bubble'' refunds a percentage of its cooldown if the bubble hits an enemy champion.

mechanics.claim: The bonus true damage from the ability is dealt before any other triggering damage from Zoe or her allies, and is always attributed to Zoe.
mechanics.quote: The '''bonus''' damage from ''Sleepy Trouble Bubble'' is dealt before '''any''' triggering damage from '''Zoe''' or her allies, and is attributed to '''Zoe''' at all times.
